ApplicationProcess.title: Application Pipeline
ApplicationProcess.subtitle: We have fixed application periods every six months. You can apply from 1 to 25 October for a programme starting in November and from 1 to 25 April for a programme starting in May.

1.title: 1. Online Application
1.description: Fill out the linked form below by April 25th.

2.title: Application Result
2.description: On April 26th, we will let you know if you are invited to the interviews.

3.title: 2. Interview at TEG Office
3.description: The interviews will take place from April 28th to May 3rd.

4.title: Admission Decision
4.description: At the end of the interview phase, you will be informed whether you have been accepted for this semester.

5.title: Kick-off & Mandatory Dates
5.intro: Only apply if you can attend the following dates:
bullets: May 30th and June 20th full days. Workshops (mandatory)
